Ooui × .NET 11

Samples that run without a server, built from this branch on every push · source

Running in this tab

Aurora — the design showcase Aurora.Ooui.Wasm — a travel journal in warm editorial style: hero photography, destination cards, search and filters, a detail page with itinerary and travellers, and a saved-places list. Models, Services, ViewModels and MAUI are separate projects, built with Community Toolkit MVVM. The MAUI app, three times over Sample.Ooui.Wasm — Models, Services, ViewModels and the MAUI app as four projects, with Community Toolkit MVVM: the counter page, a details page and real navigation with #/main. The MAUI demo controls BrowserWasmMaui — inputs, sliders, switches, lists and the MVVM task list of MauiDemoUi, all written in XAML and rendered into the DOM. Ooui without MAUI BrowserWasm — plain Ooui elements in a browser build: the message protocol and the HTML diffing run entirely in the tab.

Needs a server, so not hosted here

GitHub Pages only serves files. The samples that answer requests themselves are one command each:

SampleStartWhat it shows
Sample.Ooui.AspNetCore dotnet run --project PlatformSamples/SampleApp/Sample.Ooui.AspNetCore The same four project MAUI app, rendered by Kestrel per request and updated over /ooui.ws.
Sample.Ooui.AspNetCoreWasm dotnet run --project PlatformSamples/SampleApp/Sample.Ooui.AspNetCoreWasm One process, both rendering paths: Kestrel at /, the published bundle at /wasm/.
AspNetCoreMaui dotnet run --project PlatformSamples/AspNetCoreMaui A single MAUI page served by ASP.NET Core, with a form that posts back over the socket.
AspNetCoreMauiWasm dotnet run --project PlatformSamples/AspNetCoreMauiWasm The demo page from Kestrel and from a WebAssembly bundle under /wasm/.
AspNetCoreMvc dotnet run --project PlatformSamples/AspNetCoreMvc Ooui elements inside an MVC controller result.
ConsoleNet11 dotnet run --project PlatformSamples/ConsoleNet11 The self hosted server, including the navigation showcase.
Samples dotnet run --project Samples/Samples.csproj The original tour of Ooui's controls.

See the README for how each host works — and note that the WebAssembly samples here are served from a subfolder, which is exactly what GitHub Pages does.
